full_script: [cheerful] Frases para la vida real. Tú primero, luego yo. I'm Sofia's mom. I'm here to pick up my son. My son is sick. He won't be in today. How is he doing in school? What homework does he have? What time is the meeting? Do I need to sign anything? Is there anyone who speaks Spanish? Thank you for helping him. [excited] Guárdalo para cuando lo necesites y dime cuántas sabías.
